nom: good light Cosmic Dew Gel To Foam Water Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily (including oily-combination) skin report it controls oil and helps hide enlarged pores while cleaning thoroughly.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including some with dry-sensitive skin, mostly report it cleanses without stripping or drying, though it did not feel moisturizing enough for one reviewer and left another reviewer's face feeling dry afterward.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin most often report it balances oil and texture without stripping, though a few with combination or combination-oily skin report it broke them out badly.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with eczema, seborrheic dermatitis, or hyper-sensitive acne-prone skin, mostly report it calms and cleans without irritation or breakouts, though several other reviewers with sensitive skin report it caused breakouts or worsened their acne.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal skin reports it can still trigger breakouts for their skin.
segments.mature: One reviewer with maturing skin reports using it to add moisture while managing maskne breakouts.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the cleanser as cleansing without stripping, even for dry or dehydrated skin, though a few reviewers, including one with combination-dry skin, found it left their face feeling dry or not moisturizing enough.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers report the cleanser calms redness, including one with seborrheic dermatitis who found relief after years of flare-ups and another whose stress acne and redness calmed overnight.
concerns.barrier: A couple of reviewers describe using the cleanser to help repair a damaged skin barrier, reporting redness and dermatitis-like bumps became barely noticeable within a day or two.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are sharply divided: several reviewers, including some with combination or sensitive skin, report the cleanser caused bad breakouts or worsened their acne, while many others, including reviewers with acne-prone, oily, or sensitive skin, report it cleared breakouts and reduced acne over time.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or oily-combination skin report it manages excess oil in the T-zone effectively.

aspects.libelle: A little goes a long way
Small dispensing hole is hard to squeeze or leaks

extraits.texte: I started using this product because of the fantastic reviews, and it simply did not live up to its expectations. It didn't help my acne AT ALL, and it even broke me out. I have combination skin and my forehead and nose doubled in visible pores. Terrible.

I bought this along with another cleanser as I needed to find a new cleanser/face wash. Out of the 2 I purchased, I was really excited to try this one. I spot tested it in several areas before using it on my whole face and had no reactions so I figured I was good to go. I liked that the good light cosmic dew cleanser gave a good lather when I rubbed it between my hands and massaged it on my face. I also liked that had a better smell than the other cleanser and it felt better on my face and rinsing off, the other cleanser made my face feel a bit squeaky, if that makes sense. BUT this good light cosmic dew cleanser broke me out terribly where the other one did not. I'm really disappointed as I loved everything about it except it made my skin worse than it was before I used it. It took awhile to get my skin back to normal. I have combo, more on the oily side, very sensitive skin for reference.

I wasn't expecting much from the cleanser relative to the other items from Good Light (I was more interested in the toner and serum), but it actually ended up being my favorite of all the items I got when buying the set! The gel has a great consistency and is super foamy when rinsed which makes it an enjoyable product to use, and my skin looks better after using it. It isn't quite as non-stripping as I would like, as it leaves more of a "squeaky clean" feeling afterwards, but it's still fairly gentle. I have extremely dry skin after using tretinoin in the past, though, so your mileage may vary. If you have to try one item from Good Light, I would definitely recommend this one!
I have tried several face washes but I am set on this one! I have all of the products expect the lip balm one. I have oily skin and this definitely helps control it! Love it all

extraits.titre: Best Cleanser for Dry and Sensitive Skin
extraits.texte: I tried many cleansers in the past that didn't quite work on my skin type. They would either strip the moisture on my skin or lead to sensitivity. I have been using this one for about two weeks and think I have found the right cleanser for my skin type.

I had a feeling when I bought this based on reviews and ingredients I would love it...and I do! I have very sensitive, acne prone combo skin type. I react to anything and have to be careful. Been on my skincare journey long enough to figure what ingredients my skin likes best and what does & doesn't irritate it for the most part. This cleanser has not irritated or broke me out at all, reduced size of current atress acne significantly over night and calmed redness, removed traces of my makeup, dirt and oil, very hydrating and lathers great. Love that it has no harmful ingredients, has vitamin E & hyaluronic acid, no alcohols or artificial fragrances and is affordable. Def makes me want to look more into brand.
